database_file.description: Path to the KeePass database file to open by default

key_file.description: Path to an external key file used for authentication

histfile.description: Path to the readline history file

inactivity_timeout.description: Inactivity timeout in seconds before session lock; 0 to disable

password_generate_words.description: Use dictionary-based word generation for passwords instead of random characters

password_special_min.description: Minimum number of special characters in generated passwords

password_special_max.description: Maximum number of special characters in generated passwords

password_length.description: Length of generated passwords (chars or words)

password_special_chars.description: String of characters treated as special separators in shell commands

clipboard_clear_seconds.description: Time in seconds to clear clipboard after password copy

show_password_stars.description: Display asterisks instead of plain text for passwords during input

print_generated_password.description: Print the generated password to stdout after creation

autosave_enabled.description: Enable autosave/shadow copies when saving the database

disable_recycle_bin.description: Disable the recycle bin; deletions are permanent

read_only_mode.description: Open the database in read-only mode

startup_commands.description: Semicolon-separated list of commands to run on startup
